ground_truth.title: Helm chart does not define a NetworkPolicy for its workload
ground_truth.rationale: Without a NetworkPolicy, the workload may accept unrestricted ingress and initiate unrestricted egress where the cluster network plugin enforces policy. Explicit policy reduces lateral movement opportunities.
